severity_basis: scored on counterfactual blast radius, not observed impact; observed impact was limited only because the auditors were stopped before any deliverable landed
headline: the transcript manifest and durable mirror inferred a file's KIND from its directory and extension; 18 orchestrator shell outputs were served to four Fable auditors as subagent transcripts

detection.how: an existence check over every slice path before launch, run while investigating an unrelated missing file, led to a file-by-file look at the store
detection.note: a defect found while chasing a different symptom is a lucky catch, not a controlled one

root_cause: a tool inferred a file's kind from the directory it sat in and the extension it carried; both are properties of where the runtime put it, not of what it is. No content check existed anywhere in the chain, so nothing could disagree with the assumption.
counterfactual_blast_radius: stage-1 packets with coverage digits counting 29 transcripts and findings about orchestrator commands; the stage-2 final checker consumes those as its evidence base, and the close gate asserts a coverage statement is PRESENT, not that it is TRUE. A fit_to_close verdict would have rested on an audit of the wrong files while every mechanical check passed.
controls_installed: exclusions counted and reported in both tools rather than silently dropped
the stage-1 durable-store sweep applies the same content check
manifest rebuilt as v2 beside v1; history retained, not rewritten
23 shell outputs moved (not deleted) to sp_durable/shell_outputs/<session>/, sha256-verified at the destination before the source was unlinked, with a note recording why they are there
regression test _test_transcript_discriminator.py: 13 synthetic vectors plus every real file on both sides of the quarantine boundary; GREEN

sibling_paths_audited._extract_final_msg.py: SAFE - resolves explicit paths from the launch map, no directory enumeration
sibling_paths_audited._mirror_transcripts.py destination count: now correct because the store is curated by the same check
sibling_paths_audited.Jer and earlier books: no transcript manifest exists for them at all - they closed before OW-6. This is not a regression, it is the gap OW-6c reserves an owner decision about.

open_control_gap.gap: the close gate checks that each auditor's coverage statement EXISTS, not that its digits are true
open_control_gap.why_it_matters: this is precisely why the error would have passed the gate
open_control_gap.proposed: stage 2 must reconcile each stage-1 packet's transcript count and byte total against the manifest the slices were built from, and refuse fit_to_close on a mismatch
open_control_gap.closed_by: _final_check_reconcile.py compares every stage-1 packet against the slice plan and the manifest; the close gate runs it and refuses on RED; the stage-2 checker ran it independently and reported GREEN
open_control_gap.verified_by: the OW-6 stage-2 final checker, which was ordered to run the tool and report its verdict

authority: orchestrator self-report; candidate-only, non-authorizing; no corpus row is affected
superseded_note: this record's gap status said OPEN after it had been closed; corrected in place ONLY in the status field, with the original gap text left intact above
